attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health (Physician Assistant licensure)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Mandatory CME of the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA); suicide-prevention hours from AAPA, a hospital/licensed health care institution or a regionally accredited college
rules.alternatives: No separate state hour count: the PA must meet NCCPA mandatory CME and pass any NCCPA exam/assessment required for maintenance of certification.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; no documents sent. Keep attendance records/certificates 3 years after the year completed; submit within 45 days of a DPH request.

topics.who: All PAs: prescribing controlled substances and pain management, at least 1 contact hour in the preceding two years
All PAs: first renewal period, then at least once every 6 years; screening for PTSD, suicide risk, depression and grief, plus suicide prevention training

rules.notes: License renews annually in the birth month. Contact hour = at least 50 minutes.
